title: ReflectionMethod invoke accepts a null receiver for a static method and variadic arguments

ground_truth.statement: ReflectionMethod::invoke accepts null for the object when invoking a static method. Arguments after the receiver are passed to that method. Both explicit and omitted optional arguments work.

provenance.derivation: Upstream reflects a nonexistent method. Here a real static method permits a meaningful independent runtime check.

notes: A mixed native return avoids adding an unrelated narrowing check. The initial version checked is_string before returning, which Mago correctly recognized as redundant because it resolves this reflection target. That scaffolding was removed rather than counting a correct report as FP.
